protocol.purpose: Separate work, unique KV footprint, batch-axis factorization and q-head repetition using matched INT4/FP16 controls

inactive_splits.change: capacity multiplier 1,2,4; exact actual sequence fixed
inactive_splits.residual: extra neutral stage1 programs AND merge workspace; not pure scheduling isolation

physical_reuse.fixed: allocated buffers, Q/KV values, logical length, active program count, config
physical_reuse.residual: distinct referenced addresses/address reuse; no exact HBM traffic claim

batch_head_repartition.fixed: B*Hkv=16,Q/KV=6,total Q heads=96,logical KV elements,program count
batch_head_repartition.residual: head geometry/strides change together with batch; cannot call pure batch causal effect

q_repeat.fixed: KV tensors and bytes,B,T,Hkv; compare g1 across R and same valid g between representations
q_repeat.residual: Q work,program count and Q geometry change; compare with other interventions, not standalone instruction attribution

correctness.oracle: independent FP32 softmax on repeated identical physical pages

protocol.data_note: Synthetic diagnostic pages are deliberately identical across positions/heads. Controls preserve semantic values exactly. Not representative serving throughput. Seed varies by process, shared within matched interventions.

analysis.primary: paired GI,GF,D in each process/round; intervention contrasts within rep/g; all raw effects and process ranges retained
analysis.rules: No posthoc threshold or dropping outliers. A nonzero difference refutes exact invariance only at tested settings; small differences do not prove independence. Do not infer hardware bottleneck without profiling.

protocol.run_gate: smoke finite/oracle pass before full; source committed and clean; no full-model run in E11
